title: Broad peer-route reconciliation and evidence ceilings
mode: Primary-source review and existing plan reconciliation
scope: Re-screen independent DXF parsers, DWG readers, ACIS parsers, and native consumers by the exact stage they implement.
Reconcile new/current route observations with the existing PAR-07/S8 comparator and consumer gates.
Preserve the non-promoting DEFERRED_EXTERNAL status of J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295.

method.kind: Public primary project documentation/source pages, versioned package metadata, issue report, and official DXF reference
method.mutableSourcePolicy: Branch documentation is capability context only; any future comparator execution must pin source/artifact, route, version, and entity profile.
method.evidenceRule: Parsing, typed decode, raw-record retention, object ownership, rendered projection, ACIS shape validity, analytic geometry semantics, and native-consumer behavior are distinct outcomes.

evidence.observed: The README describes a DXF text-in/object-model-out parser, lists most 2D entities with partial MTEXT/XData, and explicitly lists 3DSolids and all leader types among unsupported areas.
evidence.limits: The published support list is not a full drawing-retention contract or evidence for binary DXF, DWG, or ACIS semantics; no package or sample was run.
evidence.planUse: Optional field/entity-specific DXF structural differential only; retain per-entity disposition and do not use parse success or output counts as whole-document parity.

evidence.observed: The README describes a Java DXF-to-SVG parser/converter, states that entity support is incomplete and text entities have problems, and lists a set of supported 2D-oriented records.
evidence.limits: A render/conversion projection cannot establish preservation of source records, uncommon object data, binary DXF, DWG, or 3D modeler bodies.
evidence.planUse: Not admitted as a general codec comparator; at most use for a named 2D rendering question with explicit projection limits.

evidence.observed: The public source exposes entity data records and callback-style processing, including traditional geometry records.
evidence.limits: This API shape is not a retained whole-document model; the source review does not establish complete record-family or version support and no executable was run.
evidence.planUse: Keep the existing narrow QCAD/dxflib route; compare only explicitly represented fields and do not infer graph or serialization fidelity.

evidence.observed: The current README labels the reader pre-alpha, reports a 19-file corpus with 3,911 decoded, 525 skipped, and 9 errored records, and documents per-record data-stream boundary checks plus named decoder gaps.
evidence.limits: The per-version corpus is small and self-selected; the README says aggregate rates change as the denominator changes. Boundary validation does not establish semantic correctness or native acceptance.
evidence.planUse: Use only an exact pinned route for container, record-boundary, or named typed-decoder differential; report per-version denominators and decoded/skipped/errored dispositions.

evidence.observed: The versioned package documentation reports 37 DWG inputs, 34 strict comparison rows, and field-level comparison against LibreDWG JSON output.
evidence.limits: The claim is project-reported and the expected values derive from LibreDWG, so this is not an independent ground-truth or geometry-semantic oracle; the corpus provenance requires separate review before execution.
evidence.planUse: A candidate only for a pinned, question-specific structural differential, with LibreDWG explicitly recorded as the shared oracle and corpus artifact hashes/provenance captured.

evidence.observed: The project describes an experimental SAT/SAB reader and conversion of selected geometry to CadQuery/OCCT; unknown or unsupported records remain raw or fail conversion.
evidence.limits: It is not a DWG container or AcDs ownership reader; supported profiles and geometry subsets are bounded, and a valid kernel shape alone is not an independently authored semantic expectation.
evidence.planUse: Only use after exact carrier/profile selection and source-lineage pinning; report parser, reference closure, shape validity, analytic checks, and consumer behavior separately.

evidence.observed: The documentation distinguishes C++ and legacy Python importers, lists a bounded C++ entity set, and says stock import cannot read ACIS solids. Confirmed issue #22214 reports a multi-layout limitation for a named C++ importer route/build.
evidence.limits: Documentation and an issue report do not establish behavior of an arbitrary current binary, converter, platform, or importer option; consumer omissions do not by themselves prove malformed DXF output.
evidence.planUse: Keep native qualification exact to importer/backend, application build, platform, options, and entity family; test layout and ACIS outcomes separately from file-structure checks.

evidence.observed: The published entity reference separates modeler-format version and proprietary modeler data from the AcDb3dSolid subclass and lists group 350 as a soft-owner handle to the history object.
evidence.limits: This is a DXF entity contract, not a DWG AcDs byte-layout definition or proof that a peer interprets the modeler payload correctly.
evidence.planUse: Keep serialized carrier bytes, history reference/ownership, and geometry semantics as separate assertions under PAR-07/S8.

evidence.observed: Reconciled the route-specific evidence grades and clarified the use of DXF projection parsers, per-record DWG coverage, shared-oracle comparisons, bounded ACIS readers, and native consumer results under existing plan owners.
evidence.limits: No production source or test changed; no external drawing, peer executable, package, native application, or kernel was run.
evidence.planUse: Use existing generated fast controls per local slice; execute a composed external route only when exact route identity and independent expected values are available.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S8: separate container/record bounds, object/owner association, exact modeler carrier, parser profile, geometric semantics, and consumer acceptance.
Peer route register: constrain DXF callback/rendering tools to represented fields and projections; label LibreDWG-derived JSON as a shared comparator oracle.
Consumer qualification: pin FreeCAD importer route/build/platform and distinguish multi-layout or unsupported-ACIS consumer limitations from source DXF structure.

planChanges: Added a source-grounded route matrix for DXF object-model parsers, callback and render-only readers, spec-led DWG decoders, ACIS-only readers, and application consumers.

Clarified that per-version decode accounting and record-boundary checks are structural evidence, not semantic-geometry acceptance; changing aggregate denominators must not be used as a direct peer benchmark.
Explicitly labelled LibreDWG JSON as go-cad's comparison oracle rather than independent ground truth, and limited the route to question-specific structural differentials.
Tightened the readiness handoff and self-unblocking rule without creating new findings, tests, fixtures, dependencies, or external gates.
limitations: This pass reconciles screened candidates and is not an exhaustive census of all open-source CAD projects.
Mutable branch pages are current-source observations, not immutable release guarantees.
No peer implementation, sample corpus, external drawing, native application, or geometry kernel was executed or downloaded.
No native/platform qualification or independent 3D semantic oracle was established; all six J items remain advisory and deferred.

validation.commitBlocker: Research-only plan update; shared worktree remains dirty and Git metadata is read-only in this session.
